Tagcast 0.70.2 is a small follow-up to 0.70.0, focused on playlist playback and clearer controls and feedback.

## Playlist playback

- **Shuffle playlist** starts a mixed play queue without changing the saved playlist order. **Play playlist** retains ordinary ordered playback. For playlists over 10,000 tracks, both actions use the current page.
- The playing track is now marked in playlist rows with the same background, accent stripe and speaker icon as album tracks. The marker follows playback changes and remains visible when returning to the playlist.

## Search and online sources

- Search fields offer a **Clear search** button while they contain text. Clearing returns focus to the field and preserves filters, sorting and existing choices. In dialogs with an explicit Search or Find button, clearing only changes the query.
- **Settings → Online sources & keys** lets you turn individual metadata and image suggestion providers off and on. All are selected by default; disabling a provider preserves its key. Artist biographies and album information retain their separate switches.

## Activity feedback and documentation

- Reviewed saves, artwork changes, playlist/folder operations, CSV import, Cleanup, tag operations and album trash now show a compact activity indicator while requests and verification are active. The **Checking saves…** badge uses the same cue. Reduced motion is respected; no percentage is invented.
- The Wiki includes a screenshot walkthrough of CSV playlist import and playlist cover comparison, including an explanation of full-library verification after a cover change.

## Downloads and upgrading

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** `tagcast-0.70.2-macos-arm64.zip`.
- **macOS Intel:** `tagcast-0.70.2-macos-x64.zip`.
- **Windows x64:** `tagcast-0.70.2-windows-x64.zip`.
- **Linux x64:** `tagcast-0.70.2-linux-x64.tar.gz`.

Every archive has a SHA-256 companion. Keep the complete extracted package together.
**Quit the older Tagcast before starting 0.70.2.** Settings, sign-in and local account favourites stay in the existing Tagcast settings folder. Browser-local preferences and Change history remain separate from Electron's profile.

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/wiki/Getting-started) and [full user guide](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/wiki). Tagcast never changes your local music files and does not install updates automatically.
